text:
Ishaan: Quick sync - launching a small pilot of the new price layers tonight in sandbox. This is a layered A/B (baseline vs layered-tier) for cost sensitivity. Need billing validation + vendor acknowledgment before we move.
Nina: What exactly is 'layered-tier'? are we changing per-token buckets or adding a per-minute window?
Ishaan: layered-tier = base per-token price + a usage-slab surcharge above 1M tokens/mo. For pilot we only enable the slab for the test cohort. No SLA changes.
Carlos: For invoices, will customers see a surcharge line or will we amortize into the unit price? we need clear line-items for reconciliation.
Ishaan: Pilot shadow invoices will include both lines (base_unit, slab_surcharge) so Finance can diff easily. Live invoices will keep the same two-line structure if promoted.
VendorOps: Vendor confirmed they can support slab metering, but asked for a written note that pilot is non-billable and limited to the early-bird cohort. They'll also require a rollback assurance.
BillingBot: [system] shadow_invoice_job queued: sj_2205 at 2026-03-05T03:00:00Z (retention 14d).
Nina: Grandfathering? which customers are protected from the slab during rollout? any pro-rata credit policy?
Ishaan: Grandfathering applies to accounts created before 2024-11-01. Protected customers will get a pro-rata credit if they cross the slab threshold within 30 days of promotion. Mapping doc link posted in thread.
Carlos: Canary size and caps? want to avoid surprise vendor billing.
Ishaan: Canary = 25 accounts (early-bird list). Per-account daily cap = 350k tokens. Global experiment spend cap = $2,500/day. Auto-rollback triggers: spend delta >20% vs baseline OR vendor errors >1%.
FinanceOps: Approvals needed: Finance lead, Vendor legal, Product PM. Please collect approvals as comments on the experiment doc; tag @finance-approvals when done. No promotion without all three.
ProductPM: I'll add a transparent banner copy for sandbox users: "You're in a pricing pilot. No live charges from this test." Will post copy in doc.
VendorOps: Vendor-legal requests the rollback paragraph in the memo; posting draft now.
BillingBot: [system] sj_2205 started at 2026-03-05T03:00:04Z
Nina: Reconciliation plan: I'll run the shadow diffs and produce a reconciled CSV: account_id, month_to_date_tokens, base_charge, slab_charge, total_delta. Will also flag any account with >30% delta.
Carlos: Please also include raw meter export so we can validate slab thresholds.
Nina: Will do.
Ishaan: TL;DR: Pilot tonight -> 25 accounts, shadow invoices with two-line items, grandfathering for accounts < 2024-11-01 with 30-day pro-rata credit, vendor memo + 3 approvals required, spend caps & rollback rules in place.
FinanceOps: Noted. We'll hold promotion until approvals are in doc.
VendorOps: Vendor-legal signed and attached attestation.
ProductPM: Banner copy posted.
Nina: Shadow diffs uploaded: avg delta +8.9%, median +7.1%, 2 accounts flagged >30% (IDs attached).
Ishaan: Reviewing flagged accounts now. If everything looks sane we'll consider expanding cohort next week.
Carlos: :eyes: Monitoring dashboards set. Will alert on billing line anomalies.
BillingBot: [system] sj_2205 completed at 2026-03-05T03:12:14Z (status: success).
Ishaan: Thanks team. Will update the rollout checklist and schedule a post-mortem tomorrow AM. Any blockers call them out now.
